en: Where to Stay: Choose the Route Segment Before the Hotel
zh: 住在路线哪一段：先选地区，再选酒店
ja: どの区間に泊まるか：ホテルより先にエリアを選ぶ

p.src: Before booking, write down the two journeys already fixed: the arrival point to the hotel, then the hotel to the first fixed stop next morning. The hotel fits the route when both are short. If arrival takes you east and morning sends you back west, an impressive lobby will not recover the time spent crossing the valley. In the figure, the lively main street remains in the distance while the four guides pause at a quieter side-street entrance. That pause turns three details into booking questions: the night entrance, the place to leave luggage, and the room's orientation. Start with the west after a Lanzhou West arrival or before a museum morning; the centre when the bridge, old streets, and dinner belong together; and the east after a Lanzhou Station arrival or for a fixed appointment near the university. Keep an airport-area night for a late landing or early flight.

caption.zh: 从主街拐进侧街后，先认夜间入口和落客点，再问房间朝向。
caption.ja: 大通りから脇道へ入ったら、夜間入口と降車地点を確かめ、部屋の向きを聞く。
caption.en: After turning from the main street into a side street, identify the night entrance and drop-off, then ask about room orientation.

p.src: This diagram shows route segments, not administrative boundaries or turn-by-turn navigation. The west keeps Lanzhou West and Gansu Provincial Museum on the same leg. The centre serves Xiguan, the south end of Zhongshan Bridge, and old-city walking. The east connects Dongfanghong Square, the university side, and Lanzhou Station. The northern airport sits in a separate panel that does not share the city scale. No hotel pins appear: one brand may have several properties, and availability, rates, and terms change even at the same property. Choose the segment first. Then use the operator's direct page to verify the full Chinese name, address, and entrance. Check transport for the actual travel date last.

caption.ja: 西側は西駅と博物館、中央は西関・橋・旧市街、東側は東方紅広場と蘭州駅につなぐ。空港泊は別に考える。
caption.en: The west serves Lanzhou West and the museum, the centre Xiguan, bridge, and old city, and the east Dongfanghong Square and Lanzhou Station. Treat an airport night separately.

p.src: Choose the central segment when dinner is followed by Zhangye Road, Xiguan, or the south end of Zhongshan Bridge. Its advantage is not proximity to every sight; it is avoiding another east-west transfer at night. Lodging near Zhengning Road makes the walk home after dinner straightforward, but it does not put the Yellow River below the window. As a property-checking example, Mercure Lanzhou Zhengning Road's direct page listed No. 11 South Yongchang Road, Chengguan, and adjacency to the Zhengning Road night market when checked on 22 August 2026. That page confirms the address and a direct contact; it does not prove that your room will be quiet. Ask which entrance works at night, whether the room faces the main street, and whether a quiet-side request can be recorded. If the museum is fixed for first thing next morning, you will still travel west.

p.src: When the ticket says Lanzhou West, consider the western segment first. The broad roof and forecourt in the figure identify this rail gate; they are not a hotel recommendation. Leave your bags at lodging around Qilihe or the west-station side, then visit Gansu Provincial Museum and continue east. There is no need to reach Zhongshan Bridge first and return for bags at night. For the metro, follow the separate station label Lanzhou West Station North Square (兰州西站北广场) inside the hub. Do not treat the national-rail and metro names as identical. If the day's final stop is central, count the post-dinner return west as a complete trip. Book only if that return is acceptable; a short line on a map is not the actual journey home.

caption.zh: 兰州西站的大屋顶和前广场是辨认这座西侧车站的线索；转地铁时要另找“兰州西站北广场”。
caption.ja: 大屋根と駅前広場は蘭州西駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。地下鉄へ移る時は、別の表示名「兰州西站北广场」を探す。
caption.en: The broad roof and forecourt help identify Lanzhou West. For the metro, look separately for Lanzhou West Station North Square.

p.src: Judge the west by Qilihe, Xizhanshizi, and Lanzhou West, not by the vague question of distance from ‘downtown’. It suits a west-station arrival, a museum first morning, or a departure from Lanzhou West after checkout. For a current reference point, Holiday Inn Express Lanzhou Jianlan's operator page placed the hotel in Qilihe and named Gansu Provincial Museum, Xizhanshizi on Line 1, and Lanzhou West when checked on 22 August 2026. Treat the operator's distances only as locating clues, not fixed journey times. Copy the live Chinese property name, Chinese address, and telephone, then check the real route from the entrance to the museum or station. If the bridge and old centre dominate the stay, you will still travel between west and centre. A lower room rate may not justify two transfers with luggage.

p.src: When the ticket says Lanzhou Station, compare the eastern segment first. The clock, station frontage, and nearby hills in the figure identify Lanzhou Station, not Lanzhou West. Nor does ‘City Center’ in an English hotel name place the property beside Zhongshan Bridge. Lodging around Dongfanghong Square, Lanzhou University, or Tianshui Road lets you drop bags after arrival and begin westward next day. For Xiguan or Qilihe, write the westward transfer in full: Line 2 if it is operating for that arrival, the interchange and final walk, or a direct ride from the signed pickup area. After a late arrival, prioritize a reliable route to the entrance. Do not drag luggage through an unfamiliar exit merely to save one fare.

caption.zh: 钟面、站房与近山是辨认东侧兰州站的线索；住在西段时，要把向东横穿城市的一段写进路线。
caption.ja: 時計、駅舎、近い山並みは東側の蘭州駅を見分ける手掛かりになる。西側に泊まるなら、東へ市内を横断する区間を旅程に入れる。
caption.en: The clock, station frontage, and nearby hills identify Lanzhou Station on the eastern side of the city. From western lodging, plan the eastbound cross-city transfer.

p.src: The east suits a Lanzhou Station arrival, a fixed appointment on the university side, or a first morning around Dongfanghong Square. Choose it because the first journey already lies in the east, not because it is ‘more modern’ than the centre. For example, Hilton Lanzhou City Center's direct page listed 3 Mid Tianshui Road, Chengguan, and described the property as part of a downtown office and shopping complex within walking distance of a metro station when checked on 22 August 2026. ‘Walking distance’ still requires a real station entrance, a suitable walking surface, and operating hours that fit the journey. The page's city-view wording does not guarantee your room type or orientation. If most evenings end at Zhongshan Bridge or Zhangye Road, each one still includes the trip back east. That tradeoff may be worthwhile before an early departure from Lanzhou Station.

p.src: Airport-area lodging solves one problem: a flight so early, or a landing so late, that entering the city would consume sleep and a sensible time buffer. Before dawn, the four guides wait with small bags for a prebooked ride. At that hour, the words ‘airport transfer’ are not enough. As a verification example, the direct Ibis Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport page advertised an approximately ten-minute drive and a complimentary 24-hour airport transfer when checked on 22 August 2026. Do not book from that sentence alone. Call the direct number and confirm the T3 pickup point, reservation requirement, waiting procedure, luggage capacity, and earliest airport drop-off. Keep the written answer with the booking. If arrival is in the afternoon and tomorrow begins at the bridge or museum, go directly to the chosen city segment rather than splitting the stay merely to be near the airport.

caption.zh: 机场附近的一夜只为保住睡眠和时间余量；订房前仍要确认T3上车点、预约方式和最早送机时间。
caption.ja: 空港周辺の一泊は睡眠と時間の余裕を守るためだけに使う。予約前にT3の乗車場所、予約方法、最も早い空港行き送迎の時刻を確かめる。
caption.en: Use one airport-area night only to protect sleep and a time buffer. Before booking, confirm the T3 pickup point, reservation procedure, and earliest transfer to the airport.

p.src: Before paying, verify the travel date, full Chinese property name and address, night entrance, direct telephone, room type, bed count, window, non-smoking requirement, quiet-side request, late-arrival hold, usable breakfast time, luggage storage, deposit and payment, and cancellation deadline. For two guests, enter both names when the booking platform requests them, and have the required documents ready for both people at arrival. Do not mistake ‘one room’ for ‘only one guest needs registration’. Current Chinese government guidance says foreign hotel guests present passports or other valid documents at reception and the hotel handles accommodation registration. A 2024 multi-department circular also opposed reception restrictions based on supposed qualifications and illegal notices refusing foreign guests. Refusal lists in old guidebooks are not evidence of current practice, though written confirmation remains prudent before a late arrival. For accessibility, ask through the complete chain: drop-off, entrance, reception, lift, door width, bedside space, and bathroom. One filter icon does not prove that route works.

p.src: Line one records the arrival point and expected arrival time. Line two records the hotel's full Chinese name, address, entrance, and telephone. Line three records the first fixed stop next morning. Line four records the one non-negotiable for this stay: twin beds, a late-arrival hold, non-smoking, or a verified accessible route. Now check both journeys on a map, arrival point to hotel and hotel to morning stop. If either still says ‘get into town and decide’, or crosses the east-west city with luggage, change the lodging segment first. When both routes can be stated, pay and retain the terms and the property's reply. The result may not be the highest-rated hotel, but it should make the Lanzhou itinerary work without unnecessary backtracking.
